business_problem: Taboola, a global ad tech and content discovery platform, uses Vertex AI, NotebookLM, and Gemini to scale ad performance, streamline sales, reduce costs, and democratize secure AI access across teams.
solution_summary: Taboola, a global ad tech and content discovery platform, uses Vertex AI, NotebookLM, and Gemini to scale ad performance, streamline sales, reduce costs, and democratize secure AI access across teams. Taboola had long relied on Google Workspace, but the adoption of Gemini, NotebookLM, and now Gemini Enterprise marked a shift from general productivity tools to company-wide AI enablement. Gemini enhanced daily tasks like email searches and meeting summaries, reducing dependency on disconnected file systems. NotebookLM added a collaborative, no-code layer to knowledge sharing. Analysts could preload curated information into shared notebooks, enabling teams to explore data and make decisions without delays. Taboola also piloted Gemini Enterprise to accelerate workflows across sales, support, and finance. Sales reps now run one-click agents to pull insights from systems like Salesforce, while finance leads can review invoice batches with contextual vendor data.
